title: What to do after a gurobipy solve, from Status and SolCount
heading: Everything You Read or Write Is an Attribute
cases: a time, node or work limit with SolCount above 0 gives 'use, report gap', and with SolCount 0 gives 'no plan: limit'
INF_OR_UNBD gives its own answer, not the infeasible one
codes outside the table, such as NUMERIC or LOADED, give 'no plan: solver failure'
